{{Infobox Slayer |name = Shades |skillreq = None |combatreq = {{SCP|Combat|30}} |otherreq = None |mazchna = 30-70 |vannaka = 40-90 |id = No }} [[Shades]] can be assigned as a [[slayer task]], with no [[Slayer]] level requirement by [[Mazchna]] and [[Vannaka]]. The easiest method to complete this task is by killing [[Loar Shades]] in [[Mor'ton|Mort'ton]] as they are much faster to kill than the level 159/140 Shades found in [[Stronghold of Security]] and [[Catacombs of Kourend]] respectively. Shades are susceptible to the [[Salve Amulet]] and [[Crumble Undead]] (however, their 40% weakness to wind spells means that [[Wind Bolt]] will do more damage than Crumble Undead for the same cost of a chaos rune, providing the player has 35 Magic or more). Combat experience gained while fighting the shades in the [[Stronghold of Security]] is drastically reduced; the player will gain 1 experience for 10 damage dealt. ==Monster Variants== {|class="wikitable sortable" |+ !Monster !Combat lvl !Slayer XP !Location !Notes |- |[[Shade]] |159 |5 |[[Stronghold of Security]] |Avoiding these is strongly recommended |- |[[Shade]] |140 |115 |[[Catacombs of Kourend]] |Safespottable, decent slayer XP.
